lead: The best offers in coaching are often sold through the worst looking funnels. I fix that part.
body: I design and build the whole journey a lead walks through, from the first landing page and the application form to the pre-call page, the Skool community and the tools your team uses behind the scenes. Most programs compete on offers and testimonials. Very few compete on how the whole thing feels, and that gap is the easiest advantage you will ever get.
close: If you're running a serious program and your funnel doesn't look as good as your results, I'd love to hear about it.
